From 4b3e4d2b43a94051b017d70461babe4e7b994aad Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001

Subject: [PATCH] tests/qtest/ufs-test.c: spelling fix: tranfer

Fixes: 631c872614ac "tests/qtest: Introduce tests for UFS"
Reviewed-by: Jeuk Kim <jeuk20.kim@samsung.com>
Reviewed-by: Thomas Huth <thuth@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Tokarev <mjt@tls.msk.ru>

diff --git a/tests/qtest/ufs-test.c b/tests/qtest/ufs-test.c
index 5daf8c9c49..95e82f9472 100644
--- a/tests/qtest/ufs-test.c
+++ b/tests/qtest/ufs-test.c
@@ -319,7 +319,7 @@ static void ufs_init(QUfs *ufs, QGuestAllocator *alloc)
     ufs_wreg(ufs, A_IE, ie);
     ufs_wreg(ufs, A_UTRIACR, 0);
 
-    /* Enable tranfer request and task management request */
+    /* Enable transfer request and task management request */
     cap = ufs_rreg(ufs, A_CAP);
     nutrs = FIELD_EX32(cap, CAP, NUTRS) + 1;
     nutmrs = FIELD_EX32(cap, CAP, NUTMRS) + 1;
--

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `tests/qtest/ufs-test.c`**
- A spelling correction was made in a comment. The word "tranfer" was changed to "transfer" in the following line:
  - Original: `/* Enable tranfer request and task management request */`
  - Modified: `/* Enable transfer request and task management request */`

### Relationships
The modification is a straightforward spelling fix that improves the clarity and correctness of the comment in the code. This change does not affect the functionality of the code but enhances its readability and professionalism. The patch is related to a previous commit that introduced tests for UFS, indicating that maintaining clear documentation is important in the context of testing.
